items.title: Sponsor dashboard by zone with quarterly summaries
items.detail: CSR sponsors need impact totals by zone and week, plus quarterly summaries for sponsored zones (FR-15, P1).
items.why: Zone and week rollups, quarterly summaries and sponsored-zone views make this a whole part, and the core rescue loop does not need it.
items.note: Saved for after the first build.

items.title: Weekly impact report with generated wording and number checks
items.detail: Donors get a weekly report of their delivered rescues with meals, kg and CO2e, written with an LLM and checked against the numbers (FR-14, P1).
items.why: It needs weekly totals, a number check, a fallback template and report wording, so it is a large feature that the core loop does not depend on.
items.note: Saved for after the first build.

items.title: Edit assumption values and rule tables with published versions
items.detail: Admins can edit assumption values and rule tables, with each change versioned and reports stating the version used (FR-16, P1).
items.why: Versioned publishing of rules that drive deadlines and impact is a whole admin part, and the first build can run on seeded versions.
items.note: Saved for after the first build.

items.title: See a per-event impact report for each caterer event
items.detail: Caterers are promised "branded weekly and per-event impact reports" ("your wedding fed 180 people"), but only the weekly report exists. No screen or endpoint gives a per-event summary.

items.title: City or ward authorities view ward-level reports and export data
items.detail: The business goal says city or ward authorities "get ward-level reports and data exports" for waste-diversion data by area. No persona, screen or endpoint serves them; only the sponsor dashboard and sponsor record download exist.

items.title: Volunteers find and take open nearby pickups
items.detail: Volunteers need "nearby tasks"; the plan's Pickups list shows only pickups already assigned to the caller, and no step lets a volunteer take an open one.

items.title: Show in-app notifications to each party when status changes
items.detail: FR-9 requires that "all parties see each change", and section 5.1 asks for simulated in-app notifications; the plan has no notification feature.

items.title: Expire listings still unclaimed or undelivered at their consume-by time
items.detail: "Any listing still unclaimed or undelivered at its deadline expires"; this must run on a clock, and timers must be rebuilt from the database after a restart (E18).

items.title: Pass an offer to the next receiver after 5 minutes without reply
items.detail: FR-8 requires that "no reply in 5 min moves the offer to the next match"; the plan only moves offers on decline, not on timeout.

items.title: Reassign or escalate when a volunteer's ETA slips past the deadline
items.detail: FR-10 and E7 require reassignment when ETA is later than deadline minus 15 min; the plan checks ETA only at claim time.

items.title: Split a large listing across up to three receivers
items.detail: E2: a quantity too large for one receiver is "split across up to 3 receivers, each with its own offer and handover code".

items.title: Widen the search to 12 km once, then close and tell the donor
items.detail: E3 requires widening the radius from 8 to 12 km, then telling the donor no match was found and closing the listing; the plan has neither step.

items.title: Post by voice note with speech-to-text
items.detail: FR-2 (P0) requires posting "by free text or voice", but no speech-to-text service appears in the plan's outside services.

items.title: Remind caterers 30 days before their FSSAI licence expires
items.detail: FR-19 asks for a "reminder 30 days before" expiry; the plan has an expiry queue for admins but no reminder sent to donors.

items.title: Log every matching and deadline decision with its inputs
items.detail: Section 5.7 requires "every status change and agent decision logged with time, actor, inputs and outputs"; the plan logs LLM calls and status changes only.

items.title: Show internal metrics for donor retention and time to claim
items.detail: Section 4 sets donor retention (posting 3 of 4 weeks) and time to claim targets; the plan's internal metrics endpoint does not compute them.

items.title: Lower a receiver's reliability score after repeated no-shows
items.detail: Section 5.6 says "repeat no-shows reduce reliability score" and fairness needs offer shares monitored; the plan has no reliability update.

items.title: Take an optional handover photo at collection
items.detail: FR-11 says handover is confirmed with "optional photo"; the collect endpoint takes a code and temperature only.

items.title: Apply an ETA multiplier for rain and late-night travel
items.detail: E17 requires a configurable ETA multiplier in matching when weather or late hours slow travel; the plan has no such setting.

items.title: Check handover codes offline and sync later
items.detail: E9 requires the code to be checked offline on the device and synced later, with status "pending sync"; the plan assumes a live connection.

items.title: Recognise volunteers for their work
items.detail: The volunteer persona gets "recognition"; the plan has no recognition shown on the volunteer's pages or profile.
